source.title: Increased connectivity of hiPSC-derived neural networks in multiphase granular hydrogel scaffolds

material: Granular HA hydrogel, 2 w/v % granules + 50 v/v % secondary crosslinker

formulation.component: secondary Extralink-1 (PEGDA) crosslinker, relative to primary
formulation.evidence: granular hydrogel mixed with solutions of secondary crosslinker at 10 v/v %, 20 v/v %, 30 v/v % and 50 v/v % (relative to the primary crosslinker concentration)

youngs_modulus.evidence: granular hydrogel mixed with solutions of secondary crosslinker at 10 v/v %, 20 v/v %, 30 v/v % and 50 v/v % (relative to the primary crosslinker concentration) acquired G′ values of 99 ± 43 Pa, 121 ± 25 Pa, 225 ± 60 Pa and 188 ± 28 Pa, respectively.

notes: Cells in this stiffer composite formed tight clusters (Figure S4). DWS microrheology at 37 °C.
